text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One important part of NLP is text understanding, which allows machines to read and make sense of written words. NLP is also used for translation, so people can communicate across different languages more easily. Another useful application is sentiment analysis, which helps companies discover whether customers feel positive or negative about a product. Finally, chatbots use NLP to answer questions and have conversations with users. Thanks to NLP, our interaction with technology is becoming more natural and helpful every day.
